rationale: The agent appeared to authenticate using name and ZIP and accessed the user’s orders, but it executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation. The final message provided no confirmation or details of the exchange outcome. Policy requires confirmation before any write and clear final information. Therefore, despite some correct steps (identifying the user, fetching orders/products), the lack of confirmation and final details causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
